notes.title: Peak Darkness Just Got Even Darker!
notes.content:
🚨 Major Update: Peak Darkness Just Got Even Darker! 🚨
Survivors, BIG things are coming to Peak Darkness—and you’re not going to want to miss this! 🔥 With Twitch Integration, Crowd Control, and exclusive perks for both The Ghost Legion and The Ghost Squad, we’re taking the game to the next level. Here's a sneak peek of everything we've been working on!

💥 New Twitch Features & Integration
Get ready for a deeper connection to Peak Darkness! With the new Twitch Integration, YOU can directly influence the game’s world through Crowd Control! Whether it’s tweaking the environment or sending chaos into the gameplay, you’ll be a part of shaping the survival experience every step of the way.

🎮 The Ghost Legion & The Ghost Squad—What's the Difference?
The Ghost Legion (Twitch Followers): You’re the backbone of our community! As a Legionnaire, your ideas help shape the game. Name guns, zombies, maps, and more! Plus, gain exclusive behind-the-scenes access and get a sneak peek at upcoming content.

The Ghost Squad (Twitch Subscribers): The Ghost Squad is the elite, the hardcore fans! You’ll unlock all the perks of the Legion, plus receive a custom weapon in-game with YOUR name on it. You’re not just playing the game—you’re helping create it. Get early access to new features, exclusive legacy content, and be a key part of the Peak Darkness future.

🔥 Why Should You Join?
Crowd Control & Twitch integration are just the beginning! By joining The Ghost Squad or The Ghost Legion, you’re not just following the development of Peak Darkness—you’re actively contributing to it. Your voice, your input, your ideas will shape the game as we move forward. 🚀

💀 What’s Next?
Here’s a sneak peek at some of the updates we’ve been working on!

[previewyoutube=tXIQt-664Ss;full][/previewyoutube]


🔫 Ready to Get Involved?
Join The Ghost Legion on Twitch to start influencing the game, or become part of The Ghost Squad for even more perks!

It’s time to survive, it’s time to evolve. 🔪

notes.title: Peak Darkness: Twitch Live Rebuild Announcement
notes.content:
Hey Survivors,

I want to speak from the heart today.

Peak Darkness has had a rough road.
Life hasn’t exactly been easy on me either.
Game development can be brutal, and there were times it felt like it might all slip away.
But here’s the thing: I never forgot about this game. I never forgot about you.
And I sure as hell have not given up.

This rebuild is not just an update:
It’s a second chance  for the game, for me, and for all of us.

What’s Happening
The Game is Being Fully Rebuilt: New systems, new maps, tighter mechanics, built from the ground up

No Band-Aids, No Half-Measures: This is a full rebuild to deliver the survival experience Peak Darkness was meant to be

Streamer-Friendly Tools: Adding features to make YOUR chat (and mine) jump into the chaos and fun seamlessly

Official Crowd Control Support: Full integration of Crowd Control so your viewers can spawn enemies, drop loot, mess with the world, and influence your survival live during 

Streamer Input Welcome: Taking real feedback from streamers on Crowd Control events and features you want to see added

 How You’re Part of This
If you’re a Follower or Subscriber on Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/igs_ghost
You’ll get:

 First Access to new builds and experimental features

 A Real Voice: Suggest ideas, vote on changes, and help shape the world with me

 Special Recognition: Exclusive rewards, shoutouts, and maybe even YOUR influence woven into the game itself

 Direct Feedback Sessions: Not "drop a comment and hope"  real conversations

 Why This Means Everything
I'm not some studio with a million-dollar budget or a marketing army behind me.
It’s just us:
IGS_Ghost, my wife IGS_Katt, my brother IGS_Nate, my sister IGS_Redbarnacles, my brother-in-arms IGS_Beastlybroom, and our emotional support champion IGS_Roxy.
We’re the heart and soul of Invisible Ghost Studios.

We’ve been knocked down, counted out, and damn near broken  but we’re still standing, still swinging, and more fired up than ever.

This rebuild is about love: love for gaming, love for survival stories, and love for the community that’s been with us through it all.
If you’re reading this, you're not just a player:
You’re family now.

Let’s build something unforgettable together.

– Ghost

notes.title: Beta Testing
notes.content:
Hello Again Peak Darkness Fans, The developer always tests his builds and now INVITES YOU to join him at hiss igs_testing_build.

1. Right Click on Peak Darkness
2. Select Properties
3. Select Betas
4. Select igs_testing_build

If you see the developer actively testing you are always welcome to join his room just look for IGS Ghost.

notes.title: Complete Rebuild
notes.content:
Hello Peak Darkness fans,  As some of you might know this game is built by one developer and it has been a crazy time for him.  But he did not forget about Peak Darkness.  He was finally able to get back to fixing and UPDATING the game.  He still has great plans for this games future so hope you enjoy the update as well as look forward to the future Darkness.

Updates: This is a complete rebuild of the game from ue4 to ue5, 2 new smaller maps allowing for more enemy's without losing performance (more to come), 6 charachters to choose from, still a wave shooter but you now have a goal to each map for an extraction, added 11 guns to start (more to come), multiple new enemy's, we now have ACHIEVEMENTS!!!  more achievements will be added soon.

Discloser:  The Fallen Cathedral map has a few small issues that is getting worked on and will have an update soon.
